titulo: Live: Thousands of students march across France as clashes reported in Lyon and Strasbourg
cuerpo: Thousands of students in France blockaded their high schools again on Tuesday, with adults joining to march in support of the weeks-long movement. Clashes between protesters and police were reported in Lyon and Strasbourg, and up to 40,000 people are expected to take to the streets of Paris. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.
